description: This is a Java source file that implements the Hibernate-specific data access object (DAO) for ProgramWorkflow entities within the OpenMRS clinical data management system. It provides methods for CRUD operations, querying programs, patient programs, concept conversions, and other workflow-related database interactions.

classes.name: HibernateProgramWorkflowDAO
classes.description: A Hibernate-specific implementation of the ProgramWorkflowDAO interface, managing database operations related to Program, PatientProgram, and Workflow entities within the OpenMRS system.

methods.name: saveProgram
methods.description: Saves or updates a Program entity in the database.

methods.name: getProgram
methods.description: Retrieves a Program by its ID.

methods.name: getAllPrograms
methods.description: Fetches all Program entities, optionally including retired ones.

methods.name: getProgramsByName
methods.description: Finds Programs matching the specified name, optionally including retired.

methods.name: findPrograms
methods.description: Searches for programs based on a name fragment.

methods.name: deleteProgram
methods.description: Deletes a Program from the database.

methods.name: savePatientProgram
methods.description: Saves or updates a PatientProgram entity.

methods.name: getPatientPrograms
methods.description: Fetches PatientProgram records based on various filters such as patient, program, dates, and voided status.

methods.name: getPatientPrograms (cohort and programs)
methods.description: Retrieves patient programs filtered by a cohort and collection of programs using HQL.

methods.name: deletePatientProgram
methods.description: Deletes a PatientProgram from the database.

methods.name: saveConceptStateConversion
methods.description: Saves or updates a ConceptStateConversion entity.

methods.name: getConceptStateConversion (by workflow and concept)
methods.description: Retrieves a ConceptStateConversion based on workflow and concept.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Fetches a ProgramWorkflowState by its ID.

methods.name: getProgramsByConcept
methods.description: Gets list of Programs associated with a specific Concept.

methods.name: getProgramWorkflowsByConcept
methods.description: Gets list of ProgramWorkflows associated with a specific Concept.

methods.name: getProgramWorkflowStatesByConcept
methods.description: Gets list of ProgramWorkflowStates associated with a Concept.

methods.name: getPatientProgramByAttributeNameAndValue
methods.description: Retrieves PatientProgram records matching attribute name and value.
